notes.title: SURPRISE - Last Year Version 1.0.23!
notes.content:
Greetings East Side High!

We know it has been a while since our last patch. The team at Undaunted Games has been hard at work porting Last Year over to Unreal Engine 5 and refactoring the source code to allow for more consistent updates, hence our silence during this period. If you join our Discord, you can keep up with the progress we have shared with our community so far! We want Last Year to be better than it's ever been but, it takes a lot of time and work. We're hoping that we can get the update finished and pushed by the end of the year. In the mean time, our community has brought some issues to our attention that required an imminent patch. This patch hopes to address those issues.

Before we proceed we have removed The Sawmill from the random map pool, therefore making it impossible to select the map now until further notice. We desperately tried fixing the map to no avail, thus the map will have to return sometime after our engine update.

With Patch 1.0.23, we're introducing:

1) MATCHMAKING CHECK: There is now a matchmaking check from this patch moving forwards. You can no longer matchmake with other players that are playing on an older version of the game. 
This was implemented to avoid cheaters using older builds of the game to ruin matches for other players.

2) FIEND COLLISION: After a classmate is freed from a grab ability, they will lose collision with the Fiend for 3 seconds. This was done to crackdown on methods that abused trapping the classmates in corners.

3) DOOR COLLISION: Tired of those pesky doors slapping you in the face when running away from the fiend? Fear the doors no more as when doors open, they will have no collision now! We hope this will reduce frustration of deaths not caused by individual fault.

4) OBJECTIVE RESET DISTANCE: The objective will now begin de-spawning if all classmates are 10 meters away.

We have also taken this opportunity to do some balance adjustments following our last patch. We were overall happy with the reception from the community however, with this new patch we wanted to experiment further. Unfortunately, we still couldn't address some larger issues with the balance such as a Strangler rework or a Deep Wounds nerf. Those will have to wait until after our engine update with proper reworks. Nonetheless we hope you will enjoy the changes and please remember to leave us feedback on our Discord!

Map Changes:
- The Mine's crank completion time has been reduced from 50 seconds to 40 seconds
- Cryptids will spawn in batches of 3 instead of 5 on The Mine

Classmate Changes:
- Gas Traps no longer reverses the affected classmate's controls
- Classmates speed when afflicted by Gas Traps has been changed from 0.5 to 0.65
- Assault Pipe damage has been decreased from 20 to 15
- Assault's Helmet scrap cost reduced from 12 to 10
- Assault's Molotov damage against Fiend reduced from 1.7 damage per 0.1 seconds to 1.2 damage per 0.1 seconds 
- Assault's Molotov damage against classmates reduced from 0.8 damage per 0.1 seconds to 0.5 damage per 0.1 seconds
- Medic's Gas Mask scrap cost reduced from 12 to 10
- Medic’s Pipebomb scrap cost reduced from 22 to 18
- Scout's Tracker recharge increased from 20 to 25

Fiend Changes:
- Strangler chokehold reduced from 5 seconds to 3 seconds
- Giant's sprint speed has been increased to Slasher's base walking speed

When working on the balance, we took the opportunity to fix some small bugs with Fiend and Classmate:
- Fixed an issue where Classmates were forced off of the crank after 25 seconds on The Mine
- Fixed an issue where Strangler pulled you indefinitely when on a different elevation from the Classmate

Thank you all for your continued support and patience for the engine update. We’re all working very hard to bring you the best Last Year experience possible. We hope to share more exciting information with you soon!

See you in the Nightmare!

notes.title: Balance Patch
notes.content:
**Hello East Side High!**

Today I want to announce our first Balance update, and walk through some of the decision making. Our goal was to bring some of the overtuned damage elements down, and make CC more of a skilled use scenario. The goal is to bring a smoother balance between roles for the game, and we’ll be monitoring and adjusting as we go.

**Medic** has been changed to heal 3hp, 0.5 second to use the charge, 1 sec to recharge medkit charges, and maximum charges reduced to 6.

**Giant**: throw damage has been smoothed out to a minimum of 30 at short range and a maximum of 60 at furthest range. On top of that, his base attack damage has been dropped to 15 from 25, as he was dealing far too much damage in conjunction with his other abilities. Finally, we’ve added a 8 second cooldown to his missed throw ability, and a 15 second cooldown when it hits.

**Strangler**: this was a tricky killer to balance and realistically we know that a rework in the future is probably needed. However, we’ve done some changes in the short term to make him feel better to play. His chain speed was sped up to 3200, twice as fast. His chain now deals 18 damage on a hit with the chain, and its min damage total from short distance is 20 more, and 36 damage for max distance. This should make the chain a key element in his damaging output, more akin to a hit and run style. His base movement speed is now 270, which is faster than before but still below classmates speed. Lastly, his stranglehold now holds for the full duration of time regardless of chain distance pull.
All killer resistances/weaknesses were set to a miniscule value as to not be noticeable in gameplay. This should make Slasher easier to harm, and Spider able to live longer in a fight.

The **Scout** tracker flash duration was reduced to 2.5 seconds, from 3.5, and it’s recharge rate reduced to 20s from 25s. The idea here was to make flash an available tool for CC but minimize it’s length so that it’s still a skill shot. Smoke duration was reduced to 4 seconds as well, to make it more of a decision when to use it. The shotgun scrap cost was increased to 32, and it’s overall damage per charge reduced to 70. This was done as it’s a ranged weapon and thus less risk involved in using it.

For **Assaults**, the Molotov scrap cost was increased to 22 from it’s low 18 cost. Baseball bat scrap cost was reduced to 30, as it’s a melee weapon and thus presents more danger in using it.

**Technicians** only real change was the flamethrower. It’s damage was increased from 6.2 per proc to 9 for a larger potential damage boost. However as it’s a ranged weapon, we’ve upped it’s scrap cost to 34.

We’ve finally tuned some of the more overperforming spells. Pent Up maximum damage reduced to 25, Healing Hands bonus reduced to 25%, The Wall bonus reduced to 15% and Human Tank spell reduced to 30% bonus. These are sharp drops, we know, but the core mechanics come first and spells are the cherry on top in terms of power. In the future we’ll be redesigning spells entirely.

Now, the future. We love the reception everyone has had and we’re aware of the desire to see more. Our next step is getting the store properly relaunched, and new cosmetics made to come out periodically. We’ve also began work on the game engine updates and code cleanup, so that we can make the game run smoother and look nicer! Finally, Chapter 2. Yes it’s coming, after we do the hard work we’ll have more to share in later months, including the newest Fiend!

Hope to see you in the Nightmare!*

notes.title: Last Year: The Nightmare finally arrives on Steam for Halloween
notes.content:
Hello Last Year fans,

Positive news to share…

As many of you already know, the development of new content had to be put on pause due to
lack of funding. It is no secret that Last Year didn’t sell a huge amount of copies, and
unfortunately this caused a problem where there wasn’t enough money to pay a team to
continue making updates.

But today we are announcing a potential new opportunity for the updates to keep coming.

But first…

We want to thank all of you who have been true fans of the game and offered positive support.
We want to let you know that even though this has been a difficult uphill battle, we *still* have
committed team members who want to keep developing and releasing new content updates.
There are multiple maps, fiends, and other awesome new features that were in the pipeline
that are waiting to be finished and released. In order to do this we need to find creative ways to
make it happen.

To celebrate this year’s Halloween and the anniversary of the Last Year Discord beta exactly
two years ago, we are announcing that Last Year: The Nightmare is coming to Steam for the
very first time and it is available to buy now. 

https://i.imgur.com/ylisGIF.jpg

Previously a Discord-only exclusive, this Classic Edition is the true OG version of the game,
complete with the original open-style maps like classic gym, no cryptids, original matchmaking,
and original game mechanics for Strangler, and much more. We also added new updates like a
balancing pass for the Killers and Survivors and Steam achievements like the infectious Covid-
96. If you die from someone who has this achievement, you become infected with it then you
can pass it on by killing others. Go try it! But remember to wear your mask in the real world
cause Covid-19 sucks!

We wanted to bring you the original Last Year in its truest form so we’ve also given this version
the ORIGINAL look and feel from the early days. The original poster, logo, and design have all
been included, plus we’ve also made an official soundtrack and official art book that showcases
the process that went into creating the original game. 

With enough proceeds from the classic edition, we could Resurrect ongoing content and keep making maps and features, and hopefully still bring it to platforms like Xbox and PlayStation. Devs are here and excited and ready to make awesome cool new stuff, we just need the resources.

We hope you’ll join us on this nostalgic trip back to OG Last Year: The Nightmare and we look
forward to seeing how you spread Covid-96 through Forest Hills.

-Last Year Squad

https://store.steampowered.com/app/511440/Last_Year_The_Nightmare/?beta=0

notes.title: LEVELING THE PLAYING FIELD! UPDATE 1.0.17 IS HERE
notes.content:
Greetings, Brother and Sisters!

It’s finally here! Elastic Games is proud to present Last Year version 1.0.17! If you do not see the prompt to update, you may need to restart your Steam client.
With Patch 1.0.17, we’ve made major improvements to your Last Year experience:

1)	BRAND NEW TUTORIALS: Last Year 1.0.17’s major feature are new tutorials for both Classmates and Fiends. The tutorials are short segments that teach the players the basics of the game, so that when they enter a match for the first time, they’re not thrown in the deep end. Both tutorials have four segments each.

2)	IMPROVED MATCHMAKING: 1.0.17 adds the Ping of players in the lobby, and now sorts lobbies by the following criteria, in this order: ping, player “rank,” then age of lobbies. The first is so that everyone playing gets the best possible gameplay experience by reducing high pings. The second is to ensure everyone is playing against players of relatively comparable skill, and the final one is to ensure that the people that have been waiting longest are served first. Because there are now more parameters than before, it’s likely that you may wait a little longer for lobbies. However, this is all in service of ensuring that everyone has the best gameplay experience.

3)	BRAND NEW COSMETICS: 1.0.17 introduces the first “premium” emotes, “Freeze Frames” for Classmates, and “Photobombs” for Fiends, which can be unlocked with Mystic Ore. The update also contains 4 new sets of collectable skins: “Camping” Skins for all characters, “Heroes and Villains” Skins for all characters, “Frost” themed skins for Fiends Characters and Classmate weapons, and “Gold” themed skins for Classmate weapons.

4)	BRAND NEW ARCANUMS: With 1.0.17, both Classmates and Fiends will have their own Arcanums! These include Spells, Challenges, Stash Card Rewards, Mystic Ore Rewards, and exclusive Skin Rewards. Once spells are unlocked and equipped, they will stay equipped until swapped out by the player. All Classmates can equip two spells, and Fiends can equip one spell per Fiend in their Fiend Decks. Since Tokens are no longer needed to unlock/buy spells, they have been removed from the game.

5)	REWARD REWORK: Starting with 1.0.17, individual performances now determine the amount of Stash Cards awarded at the end of a match. For Classmates, advancing objectives, killing Fiends, rescuing Classmates, and escaping determine your cards. For Fiends, killing Classmates, springing traps, successful ambushes, and preventing escapes determines your cards. The Team or Fiend performance will now act as a multiplier on the base amount of Stash Cards you received from your performance: 0-2 escapes/kills awards +10% cards, 3-4 awards 25%, and 5 awards 50%. This allows players to continue their progress in a predictable way, no matter what kind of game session they get, with exceptionally great performances on either side getting a bit more of a boost at the end.

6)	FIEND UTILITY ABILITIES: Each Fiend now has a distinct Utility Ability that will allow them to engage or disengage with the Classmates more easily, allowing them to set the pace of combat. None of these abilities will do damage to the Classmates but will instead give the Fiends more opportunities to be creative in how they can deal damage, or escape from being damaged, when in combat with Classmates.

7)	DAILY TRIALS: These are small challenges that players will receive every 24 hours should they log into the game, and will reward the player with small amounts of currency to help them towards their cosmetics goals. Some challenges are easier, could be completed in 1 or 2 matches, and will reward players with Stash Cards. Others are tougher, probably need 3 or 4 matches to complete, and reward players with Mystic Ore. Each player receives two challenges a day: one for Classmates, and one for Fiends.

We’ve also made several balance changes and bug fixes. While they are very numerous and subtle, here are some of the bigger, more noticeable changes we’ve made:

-	All levels now start with the Classmates “locked in” their opening room until The Fiend spawns into the game
-	Classmates no longer have collision with one another
-	Fiends no longer have collision with Cryptids
-	All speed values have been adjusted to compensate for the above changes
-	Maximum scrap has been increased to 40, and most scrap costs for items have been adjusted for balance purposes
-	Flashlights have been added to levels as items that can be picked up
-	The Slasher has been given two more ambushes in The Sawmill map
-	Classmates are now invulnerable and lack collision when respawning from a rescue room to allow them to escape The Fiend. Attacking or performing actions will cancel the invulnerability state
-	The Slasher’s Cleave ability now knocks Classmates back
-	The Spider’s venom now destroys turrets
-	The controller layout for Fiends has been improved: both trigger buttons now push or throw the Classmates when they are grabbed by the Strangler and Giant, and the quick execution button for Strangler is now mapped to X
-	The helmet now has a health bar displayed for the Fiend similar to the Fiend’s Shield health bar
-	Fiends’ basic attack damage has been increased slightly
-	The Spider now has both a walk and sprint speed
-	Adrenaline no longer provides a speed boost, but now heals for 30 HP. It still gives infinite stamina
-	Pipe bombs and Proximity Mines now do slightly more damage to Classmates, killing them instantly if they are at “ground zero”
-	Fixed bug in the Belltower escape sequence that blocked Fiends from spawning out
-	Fixed performance drop whenever rescue rooms are opened
-	Optimized AI to improve framerate and performance
-	Fire and explosions no longer destroy objectives

We’ll be monitoring the community to ensure these changes and fixes are working and being well received. This is our most ambitious update to the game so far, and we’ve very excited to see the community’s reaction to it!

Thank you all again for the continued support of this title, and your faith in this dev team. We’re all working very hard to bring you the best Last Year experience possible!

See you in The Nightmare!

Unitas,
Brother Justin

notes.title: The Return of The Medic! Update 1.0.16 is here!
notes.content:
Greetings Brothers and Sisters!

Get ready to stand up and fight, Classmates! The medic is back, better than ever before.

Update 1.0.16 brings to a close our “Bloody Valentine” event, which means that the “Bloody Valentine” event skins will no longer be available for purchase... for now. There will be more events in the future, so keep your eyes peeled for future limited-time skins!

We are pleased to announce that Last Year Patch 1.0.16 is now available! It is about 440MB in size. If you do not see the prompt to update, you may need to restart your Steam client.

With Patch 1.0.16, we’ve made major improvements to your Last Year experience:

1)    NEW ITEM: The Gas Mask! All medics now sport the Gas Mask as a craftable item instead of the Flashlight. The Gas Mask allows players to ignore the effects of both the Fiend’s Gas Traps and the Scout’s Smoke Grenade. Exposure to gas, or straight damage, will reduce the “health” of the Gas Mask. If a Classmate crafts another Gas Mask while wearing one, it will refill the Mask’s health, but they will not “drop” the 2nd Gas Mask. NOTE: Due to the powerful nature of this item, especially in combination with the Smoke Grenade, we have changed the behavior of Classmates in the Smoke Grenade. Classmates are no longer able to complete objectives or open rescue doors inside of the smoke, unless they are wearing a Gas Mask.

2)    NEW SKINS! The Gas Mask also comes with 5 alternate skins, 2 of which are Legendaries! Sport classic looks like “Hot Rod” and “Doosh Beer,” unlock “Field Medic” to match with your MedKit, or earn “The Old Fashioned” and “Safe Word” to show off to your fellow Classmates!

3)    NEW EXECUTION! The Spider’s fourth and final execution, “The Rabid Animal,” is now activated by approaching downed Classmates from the “front.” Watch as The Spider plays with his food like a chew toy, sending their limbs flying everywhere!

4)    Ore Stickers: We’ve labelled all “Ore” skins with an “Ore Sticker,” so it’s clearer to players which skins need to be purchased with Ore. In the future, all skins that are purchasable with Ore will have this label.

5)    Balancing Polish: We’ve been monitoring the community and we’ve made a few small changes to balance to make the experience more engaging and less frustrating for both sides:

a.    Fiends can no longer attack or execute incapacitated Classmates in the Smoke Grenade.
b.    Fiend’s basic attack hitboxes have been standardized, and are identical to the Pipe’s hitbox.
c.    Medics’ MedKit now recharge faster.
d.    Flamethrower’s controls have been greatly improved, and its damage has been standardized to 140 health.
e.    The Giant’s Goliath Rush is no longer interrupted by small objects or tiny obstructions.

6)    Bug Fixes: We’re continuing to address bugs, prioritizing those that have an effect on gameplay and balance. Here is a list of issues we’ve resolved:

-    The Giant can now be damaged from the front when holding a Classmate (note: the one exception is the Shotgun. We will address this in a future patch)
-    All music states, including the “Chase Music,” have been fixed
-    The Escape Gate Closing Cinematic now appears at the end of each round, unless the Fiend kills all Classmates
-    Cooldowns can no longer be “hastened” when using a Shocker on a Fiend with a long cooldown triggered
-    The Spectator Camera is no longer broken after certain Fiend executions
-    Character Models will no longer overlap in the Lobby
-    Classmates can no longer have 3 of a given Class
-    The loud SFX before an execution has been fixed
-    Execution SFX can no longer “stack” and play over each other
-    A loot box on the floor of the laundry room of the Gym can now be looted
-    Giant no longer loses Grab/Rush functionality after attempting to Jump and Grab simultaneously
-    All skins earned in the Rewards Screen unlock properly in The Locker
-    Classmates can no longer be attacked by Cryptids while being held by the Giant

We’ll be monitoring the community to ensure these changes and fixes are working and being well received. We’re hoping this patch brings us closer to Fiend & Classmate equilibrium, as the Medic improvements, as well as balance changes, really feel solid for both sides!

We’re still focused on improving the Onboarding Experience for our next few updates, but we’ve also got a few surprises up our sleeves. As always, we can’t wait to share with you what’s coming up!

In that vein, please join us tonight at twitch.tv/LastYearGame from 4-6 PM EST for our latest Live Dev Stream! We’ll be talking about this update, answering questions, and talking about the future of the game and our Dev Streams. We hope to see you all there!

Thank you all again for the continued support of this title, and your faith in this dev team. We’re all working very hard to bring you the best Last Year experience possible!

Unitas,
Brother Justin

notes.title: FIENDS ASSEMBLE! UPDATE 1.0.15 IS HERE...
notes.content:
Greetings Brothers and Sisters!

As always, Elastic Games is here with another update for the Last Year community!

We are pleased to announce that Last Year Patch 1.0.15 is now available! If you do not see the prompt to update, you may need to restart your Steam client.

With Patch 1.0.15, we’ve made major improvements to your Last Year experience:

1)	Ambushes for Sawmill Map: All Fiends now have ambushes in the new Sawmill map! The Strangler and Giant were given two ambushes, and The Slasher and Spider have… more. Additionally, The Slasher’s ambush is completely different than his School Map ambushes, so keep your eyes peeled!

2)	Escape Vents for Sawmill Map: Classmates can now more easily evade the Fiend, especially when alone, in the Sawmill map thanks to the addition of escape vents! There are now 8 escape vents throughout the map, 2 in the sawmill area, 2 in the cave area, and 4 in the barn area.

3)	Optimization: We’ve done another pass of optimization to help improve performance and reduce drops in FPS. We concentrated on The Sawmill Map, especially in the cave area. We’ll be continuing to see what other improvements can be made without sacrificing quality of experience.

4)	“Mercy” mechanic: We’ve added a “mercy” mechanic to the Legendary Skins, which will ensure no one suffers from bad RNG luck. The new system raises the chances of getting a Legendary skin for every complete match played until it reaches 100%. This will make sure that everyone, regardless of luck, will get a steady stream of Legendaries as long as they continue to engage with the title and complete full matches.

5)	Hitbox Optimizations: We’ve reworked the hitboxes for both Classmates and Fiends to improve hit registration, fix inconsistencies with crouching and sequences, make the Giant Grab more reliable, and improve the overall “gameplay feel” of combat. We will continue to see what other improvements can be made so everyone feels the game is “fair.” 

6)	Balancing Polish: We’ve been monitoring the community and made a few small changes to balance to make the Fiends slightly more Fearsome:

a.	Strangler will now hold Classmates longer if he chains them from closer. At the closest distances, he will hold Classmates for 2.5 seconds. This decreases until the midpoint of the chain’s max range, where he will hold Classmates for 1 second. Any further will stay at 1 second. Many thanks to Haddix for the suggestion!
b.	Spider spits 2x as much venom, lasting for 1.5 seconds of spit time, and its base damage has been increased to 15 without venom, and 20 with venom.
c.	Strangler and Slasher can now down Classmates in one less hit.
d.	Every cool down, with the exception of The Spider, is now 20 seconds for a successful attack, and 10 for an interrupted or missed attack.
e.	The Fiend Shield now begins to recharge after 4 seconds, instead of 8, and will not recharge immediately after an execution.
f.	Classmate respawn times now increase by 15 seconds with each kill, and Fiend respawn time starts at 45 seconds, and reduces by 4 seconds with each Classmate alive, making its range of respawn times 41 seconds max and 29 seconds minimum.
g.	The taser now “holds” Fiends for a very short time, but puts the Fiend’s ability on a 10 second cool down. It still interrupts Fiends who are holding Classmates.
h.	Medics now recharge slightly slower.

7)	Bug Fixes: We’re continuing to address bugs, prioritizing those that have an effect on gameplay and balance. Here is a list of issues we’ve resolved:

-	The Ice Queen Spider Skin can now be earned through Legendary drops
-	Flamethrower “double damage” has been fixed
-	Medics can no longer get stuck in 3rd person and lose functionality
-	Collision fixes to Sawmill map to reduce players getting “stuck” in areas. We are continuing to monitor for these kinds of bugs
-	Giant no longer loses functionality after spawning in from Predator Mode, pressing Grab, and spawning out again
-	Giant no longer loses functionality when falling down a ledge during his attempted grab animation
-	It is no longer possible to access the escape gate before completing the crank objective in the Sawmill map
-	Classmates are no longer able to use the Flamethrower or the Chainsaw while crouched
-	Tips on the Loading Screen will no longer fade in, then out, then back in again

KNOWN ISSUES:
-	Classmates can “overlap” in lobbies if they back out and re-enter a lobby. This will not prevent the match from starting once 5 players join, even if it looks like 4 or fewer players.
-	The Giant cannot take damage from the front while holding a Classmate. He can be hit from the sides or in the back.
-	In the Library, Fiends will sometimes miss hitting Classmates inserting Disks.
-	The “Escape Gate Closing” cinematic no longer triggers in most cases.

We’ll be monitoring the community to ensure these changes and fixes are working and being well received. We’re hoping this will encourage Fiend players that our intention is to have a fun, engaging experience for both sides!

On that note, we’ll be kicking off our new milestone Monday, where our primary focus will be improving the Onboarding Experience, and ensuring that the Fiend experience is rewarding and living up to its fantasy. We can’t wait to share with you what’s coming up!

Thank you all again for the continued support of this title, and your faith in this dev team. We’re all working very hard to bring you the best Last Year experience possible!

Unitas,
Brother Justin

notes.title: FIENDS REJOICE! NEW UPDATE, 1.0.15, COMING SOON
notes.content:
Greetings, Brothers and Sisters!

While we did announce that we'd like to move to bi-weekly patches, we have been monitoring a few more egregious issues in the current live build and have decided that a patch is needed this week to address them.

We'll be providing in-depth build notes once the patch goes live, as always, but here's a high-level overview of what will be in 1.0.15:

1) Fixes for Crouching/Hitbox issues. We're aware this is causing extreme frustration, especially for Fiend players, so we're doing all we can to resolve these. This includes both the difficulty hitting crouched players and the ability for crouched players to use certain items.

2) Balance updates. While we're very happy with where the overall balance is heading now, we are aware that Fiends got hit particularly hard in the last update. We want to make a few small changes that will be the first step in restoring the overall "flavour" of each Fiend, such as cooldown times and The Strangler's Chain Pull ability.

3) Sawmill polish. We love how much the community has enjoyed the new Sawmill map, but we did have a few polish items and bug fixes that we wanted to prioritize. We hope you'll be excited with the changes we'll be introducing, both for Fiend and for Classmates.

We're hoping to push this fix out tomorrow as early as possible, and will continue to update the community as we know more.

As always, thank you for your support and patience as we try to bring you all the best Last Year experience possible.

Unitas,
Brother Justin

notes.title: LAST YEAR - UPDATE 1.0.13 IS LIVE!
notes.content:
Greetings, Brothers and Sisters!

The time has come! Our biggest update yet, 1.0.13, is finally here! If you do not see the prompt to update, you may need to restart your Steam client. 

With Patch 1.0.13, we’ve made major improvements to your Last Year experience:

NEW MAP: THE SAWMILL!
Get ready for carnage! The first in the “Afterdark” series of Forest Maps, The Sawmill is our introduction to the area of The Nightmare that The Spider calls home. The Sawmill is a completely new environment, and introduces a brand-new mechanic: Environmental Kills! Between sawblades and rushing trains, both Classmates and Fiends will have to be extra careful navigating this new haunted house style experience!

NEW WEAPON: THE CHAINSAW!
Take on the Fiends with our first devastating Heavy Weapon: The Chainsaw! Classmates will find it in a specific spawn point in the new map, but will be unable to run or carry quest items while wielding this awesomely powerful weapon. Find it and go carve out a name for yourself!

NEW FEATURE: THE SHOP!
Want a little extra currency to buy that cosmetic you like? Wish you could support the Last Year Dev Team AND flex with unique skins? Then the Shop is for you! The Shop will allow players to spend real money to buy more Stash Cards, get our new hard currency, Mystic Ore, or purchase bundles that include a skin, some cards, and ore for discounted prices! Come one, come all!

NEW COSMETICS: BLOODY VALENTINE AND MORE!
We’ve introduced brand new cosmetics for players to unlock. Grind your cards to unlock the timed exclusive Bloody Valentine event skins, complete matches to earn brand new Legendary skins, or purchase Mystic Ore to get our first Ore exclusive skins! There’s something for everyone, both new and returning players!

NEW META: COMPLETE BALANCE OVERHAUL!
Last Year is all about the tug of war between our Fearsome Fiends and Dream Teams of Classmates, and we’re doubling down on that with this update! We’ve seen frustrations on both sides of the experience, and we’ve reworked the second to second experience to maximize play time, encourage experimentation, allow players to recover from mistakes, and encourage meaningful choices at every level of play. 

Here’s a list of some of the biggest changes we’ve made:

•	Player outlines have been restored, and Fiend is now visible in a unique purple outline when engaged with Classmates
•	Classmates now have a “restoration” mechanic, which heals them automatically when they are under 30 HP
•	The base damage on Pipes and Turret Fire have been increased
•	The damage on both the Bat and the Shotgun have been increased
•	The scrap costs for the following items have slightly increased: The Bat, The Helmet, The Gas Bomb, Adrenaline, and The Shotgun
•	Medics now heal faster, regenerate charges faster, heal stamina as well as health, but heal less HP per charge
•	The Scout tracker now fires quicker, blinds for slightly longer, but recharges a little slower
•	Technicians are locked in place longer when destroying their turrets
•	Successful melee weapon attacks now drain stamina, and Classmates cannot melee attack at low stamina
•	Helmet HP has been reduced
•	Taser now stops firing much faster when the target is missed
•	Base health when getting up from being incapacitated is now 25 HP
•	Stamina drain and recharge has been reviewed to prioritize escaping
•	Fiends now have a “Nightmare Shield” that recharges when spawned out
•	Fiends’ health has been increased
•	Fiends’ basic attack damage has been curbed
•	Fiends’ special attack damage and cooldown times have been increased
•	Fiends now have unlimited stamina
•	Fiends are now resistant and/or vulnerable to certain elemental damage types
•	Fiends no longer have “blood feedback” when damaged
•	The Slasher has been given a brand-new ability, The Cleave, which damages multiple Classmates in front him
•	The Strangler’s Chain Grab is now slower, but can only be interrupted with a Scout Tracker’s flash or a Taser
•	The Strangler’s Chain Grab also does not automatically remove The Helmet, it simply deals damage until the Helmet is destroyed, and the grab continues
•	Shock damage now deals extra damage to the “Nightmare Shield,” and Fiends will take extra damage to their Nightmare Shields while being shocked by the Taser
•	The following Spells have been adjusted:
o	Human Tank slows Classmates down more, but shields more damage
o	Resilient now grants more health
o	Last Man Standing gives more health
o	Leech restores less health to Classmates
o	Lone Wolf now activates within a shorter distance
o	Take That does extra damage on its last hit
o	Acid Damage has been reduced
o	Fire Damage has been reduced
o	Shock now deals extra damage to Nightmare Shield
o	Carpet Bomb clusters do less damage
o	Huddle Up’s health boost has been lowered
o	All cooldowns for Spells are now longer

As always, we’ve also done another pass of optimization to help improve performance and reduce drops in FPS, specifically when experiencing the game on lower quality settings. We’ll be continuing to see what other improvements can be made without sacrificing quality of experience. Finally…

NEW BUG FIXES!

We’re continuing to address certain bugs, prioritizing those that have an effect on gameplay and balance. Here is a list of issues we’ve resolved:

•	Giant no longer loses functionality after dropping a classmate due to explosion
•	"Just A Tip" text no longer moves depending on the size of the tip
•	Player's Map Vote Selection is no longer Reset if another player leaves the Lobby
•	Classmates can no longer move at walking speed while crouching
•	The unlootable loot box on the floor of the laundry room of the Gym has been moved and fixed
•	Proximity Mines no longer fail to arm in certain situations
•	Giant can no longer throw players out of world in the basement hallway on the Library map
•	The Spider can now spawn out while inside a porta potty with a Classmate nearby
•	Classmates no longer earn “Kill” rewards for killing other Classmates
•	Nick's "Earl Grey, Hot" Skin model now reflects the image on the card
•	Using huddle up with the gear now has the proper VFX
•	Huddle Up health effect no longer remains after completing a disk objective
•	Giant no longer plays the Flash blinded animation when flashed while holding a Classmate 

KNOWN ISSUES:
•	The comeback mechanic sometimes does not work in the new map
•	Creating an unranked party and spamming clicks on "Kill" to bring you to the Lobby might kick users from your party and leave them on the main menu. If the host clicks on the "Back" button thereafter, they might crash. Workaround: Don't spam click "Kill" in Unranked parties! Just click it once.
•	Switching items while discarding a broken item could result in the player not being able to do anything except walk. Workaround: keep spamming the switching items button until the discard animation comes back and let it complete.

The new package size is approx. 11 GB in total, which means a download of approx. 3.3 GB for a user who already has Last Year installed on their computer. This size increase is directly related to all of the new content described above.

This is the biggest update we’ve done for Last Year since its launch, but it is definitely not its last! Just like after launch, we’ll be monitoring and playing with the community to see if there are any major pain points that need fixing, and we will react as quickly as possible to those.

We’re also planning a patch for this update which should include not only additional bug fixes, but potentially new features and content as well! We’re hoping to drop this in the following weeks, before the “Bloody Valentine” event comes to a close and the timed exclusive skins disappear for now!

Lastly, we’re going to be hosting a Live Dev Steam at twitch.tv/lastyeargame on Friday, February 14th at 2 PM EST to show off the new content, answer all your questions about the Bloody Valentine event, and get into some Devs vs Fearsome Fiend action with our special guest star, Dee! We hope to see you all there, at our new date and time.

As always, we want thank you all for your continued support and patience. This is just the beginning of the support we’d like to give Last Year throughout 2020 and beyond! We’re already beginning to plan out our future milestones to ensure we’re creating the best possible Last Year experience, and we hope you’ll be with us for this amazing journey!

Speak to you soon, Brothers and Sisters!

Unitas,
Brother Justin

notes.title: Last Year Patch 1.0.12 Has Arrived
notes.content:
More good news from the team:

Greetings, Brothers and Sisters! It’s here, and as promised, it’s a doozy!

We are pleased to announce that Last Year Patch 1.0.12 is now available! If you do not see the prompt to update, you may need to restart your Steam client.

With Patch 1.0.12, we’ve made more improvements to your Last Year experience:

1.   Easy Anti-Cheat Integration: As promised, we’ve implemented more robust reporting/banning tools to ensure a healthy, happy community. Players will now be able to report toxic behavior through an in game “report” button on the “Start Button” screen. The report button is located right next to the mute button. These reports will be reviewed by the development team, and should there be a solid case for banning individuals from play, we can now ban them from the game for a certain period of time, or give them a permanent Steam Game Ban. As we’ve said before, we prefer if people played with good sportsmanship in mind, but we are not afraid to remove bad apples to preserve the health of the community.

2.   “Free For All” Mode: We’ve changed the Unranked Matches to allow players to start a match with fewer than 6 players, but no less than 2 (a Fiend and a Classmate). This will allow friends to experience the game together regardless of party size, and allow experimentation and learning in a safer environment than online play. This is the first step in our on-boarding overhaul, with many more features and content geared towards making the game more accessible to new players coming in the following weeks/months.

3.   Tool Tips: We’ve reinstated and updated our Tool Tips feature, which will now be present in both the Loading Screens and the “Home” page. These are helpful tips geared towards new players. This is another step in our on-boarding overhaul.

4.   Map Vote: We’ve implemented a Map Vote feature in the Lobby menu, both in Ranked and Unranked matches. This allows all players to vote for which map will be played next. “Undecided” votes do not count towards the total. In the case of a tie, the game chooses between the two or three maps that have the most votes. Be warned, however: the more Classmates vote for the same map, the more powerful the Fiend’s vote becomes!

5.   Balance Changes: Patch 1.0.12 contains a few minor foundational changes for our balance overhaul that will be completed in 1.0.13. These changes are needed, but do not represent the sum total of where we see the “meta” heading next. However, this should help reduce some frustrations on both sides:

 Classmates will no longer drop their old helmets when crafting a new one. Effectively, only Assault Classes can now wear helmets.
 The Proximity Mine’s damage has been reduced to 120 damage, and has had its scrap cost increased to 16 scrap.
 The Pipe Bomb’s damage has been reduced to 120.
 The Pain Pills now only restore 40 health over 10 seconds, reduced from 80 over 15 seconds, and has had its scrap cost increased to 12 scrap.
 The Shotgun now deals 80 damage per hit, at its most effective range.
 All Scrap takes 10 seconds more to respawn in maps.
 Traps now break after 30 damage, and only last for 5 seconds after a Classmate has been trapped.
 The Giant’s hold time has been reduced from 15 seconds to 6 seconds.

6.   Bug Fixes: We’re continuing to address bugs, prioritizing those that have an effect on gameplay and balance. Here is a list of issues we’ve resolved:

 Both Classmates and Fiends now have a “Bloody Screen” feedback when hit by each other (except punches, because you really shouldn’t be punching the Fiend). Classmates’ screens stay bloody under 35 HP.
 It is no longer possible to move at walking speed while crouching.
 Classmates can no longer use any form of attack and land hits while in a Smoke Bomb.

As we stated last patch, this patch is much more focused on quality of life features, and begins the groundwork for both our balancing overhaul (which hopefully will be completed in 1.0.13) and our on-boarding overhaul (which will continue over the next few months with lots of new features and content).

We’re also going to remind the community that there will be no patch next week, February 3rd-7th, so the team can focus on delivering Patch 1.0.13 for the following week. It’s going to be a big update, and we’re excited to see you all there and to hopefully bring in new players and entice old players to return!

As always, we would encourage those who may have left a negative review of the title to consider changing it to positive if our fixes and improvements have addressed your concerns. We’re always reading our reviews and the Discord server to see how we can best improve the game for our community, and some of the features in this patch were directly requested or inspired by comments we’ve seen there. We hope this is appreciated by the community and could hopefully be reflected in your reviews.

We thank you all for your continued support and patience. We’re very excited to bring you all 1.0.13, it’s going to be one hell of an event! Please join us tonight for our Live Dev Stream on twitch.tv/lastyeargame, starting at 7PM EST. We’ll be answering questions from the community, and hosting our first #FearsomeFiend match-up against the very talented Marth!

Speak to you soon, Brothers and Sisters!

Sincerely,
Brother Justin

notes.title: Last Year Patch 1.0.8 has Arrived!
notes.content:
The Dev Team has been hard at work to bring you more good news:

Greetings, Brothers and Sisters!

We are pleased to announce that Last Year Patch 1.0.8 is now available! If you do not see the prompt to update, you may need to restart your Steam client.

With Patch 1.0.8, we’ve made more improvements to your Last Year experience:

1.    Push to Talk: We’ve introduced Push to Talk functionality to the VOIP system in Last Year. It is on by default, but can be switched to a toggle mode in the Audio Settings, and can be bound to any key on the Keyboard. The toggle mode is especially useful for players using a Gamepad.

2.    Fiend Lobby Queue Feedback: We’ve introduced feedback in a Fiend’s lobby to display an estimate of their position in the queue. This can help players better gauge the Fiend lobby wait times. 

3.    Optimization: We’ve done a second pass of optimization to help improve performance and reduce drops in FPS. We’ve also specifically optimized performance when The Spider spits their Venom ability. We’ll be continuing to see what other improvements can be made without sacrificing quality of experience.

4.    Balancing: We’ve continued to adjust the balance of the game to reduce player pain on both sides of the experience, this time with more of a focus on competitive play between expert Fiends and Classmates. Here is a list of the most impactful changes we’ve made:

 Acid now deals damage to incapacitated Classmates.
 The Execution Prompt now appears much sooner after incapacitating a Classmate.
 Hitting Classmates who are gassed now releases them from the gassed state.
 The Damage Reflection effect of “I am Rubber” has been reduced.
 The Bleeding Damage effect of “Bloody Gash” has been reduced.
 The cost of Smoke Bombs has been increased to 12.
 The shotgun has been optimized further to ensure ease of use.
 The damage done to a Classmate when thrown by The Giant is also done to other Classmates when they are hit by the throw.
 The base attack of The Strangler’s Claw attack has been increased to 25, and his health has increased to 230.
 All animation montages stop when triggering a trap, preventing “double trapping.”
 All Fiend abilities no longer “reset” their cooldowns when Spawning Out.
 There is now a small percentage chance (1%) of Legendary Skins dropping for 1-3 Escapes/Kills. The percentages at 4 and 5 Escapes/Kills have been reduced to 5% and 10% respectively.
 The maximum tokens players can earn in a round have been changed to 1600 for killers and survivors. Escape/Victory bonuses have been reduced, but other actions have been increased.


5.    Bug Fixes: We’ve begun to address certain bugs, prioritizing those that have an effect on gameplay and balance. Here is a list of issues we’ve resolved:

 Classes are no longer pre-Selected, which resulted in several bugs.
 Fixed infinite hang when a player left a lobby after the match started loading.
 Shotgun hits now register more frequently. This is the first in more planned improvements to this item.
 Fixed Fatal Error Crash while loading into levels.
 Fixed issue on Belltower where Fiends could attack Classmates through the Gear Gates.
 Fixed issue where removing the first lock from the sewers would make the Classmate back into the ambush spot of The Strangler.
 Fixed issue where Kitchen Rescue Room spawned no Classmates during the first phase of the match and removed Kitchen from potential Rescue Rooms when Classmates have reached the Belltower Courtyard.
 Fixed issue where it was difficult to place a trap on the last ledge of the escape sequence in The Belltower.


This is likely the last patch we release before we break for the Winter Holidays. We’ll be monitoring (and playing!) the game during the holidays to see how the meta settles and prepare for what changes and improvements could be made in the New Year. Until then, enjoy the game, and please support our community by being respectful, fair, and by displaying good sportsmanship while playing Last Year.

We thank you for your continued support and patience. We’re all humbled by the outpouring of love and support we’ve received since launch, and we remain committed to growing this title and its community in 2020! 

Feel free to head over to the Review Section on our Steam page and let us know how you feel about Last Year, and don’t forget to join our Live Dev Stream tomorrow at 7-9 PM EST for a Sneak Peek at Chapter 2 of the Last Year Universe!

Sincerely,
Brother Justin

 The “slow” effect on the Spider Venom has been reduced.
 Two Spider ambushes have been removed from the Gym basement, prioritizing those that were nearly impossible to avoid, even if detected.
 The damage over time on the Flamethrower has been reduced.

 Cryptid Nests no longer spawn indefinitely in The Library Map.
 Molotov Cocktails now damage Cryptid Nests.

notes.title: Patch Patch 1.0.5 HOT FIX
notes.content:
I bring you more news from the Dev team & Brother Justin!

Greetings Brothers and Sisters!

We’ve just pushed another update to improve matchmaking. You should restart your Steam client to ensure the update is working. We’ve optimized the fix that went out yesterday, and the community should be seeing even quicker matchmaking results, as well as fewer “hangs” or long loading time for entering lobbies. 

There are two known issues with this update that we're currently looking at:

 Canceling and restarting your lobby searches in rapid succession could cause the game to crash. 
 If you are in a party and are experiencing long load times into a lobby (especially when your party-mates are not), you may be stuck in a hang. The only solution is to quit the title and restart.

We’re diligently observing and listening to the community and are committed to improving the Last Year experience. However, the kind of issues we’re facing right now are only discoverable and testable when tons and tons of people test the system simultaneously. Our Dev and QA teams are small, and are doing everything to ensure the fixes we’re pushing out work, but it’s only once the community engages with the title that we can be 100% sure the issues are fixed.

As such, we ask for your help, support, and patience as we work through these issues. Your support has always been what makes this game and community special, and this is even more important now that we’re on Steam. Every issue we identify and tackle together takes us all one step closer to having the best possible Last Year experience.

We’re prioritizing matchmaking for now, as this is the most important issue: making sure players get into the game. 

However, we have identified other concerns from the community, and will be tackling them in the following order over the next few days and weeks:
-         Matchmaking
-         Optimization/Performance
-         Balancing
-         Bug Fixes

We’re going to keep communicating with all of you to ensure you’re up to date on all the latest progress.

As always, we thank you for your love, support, and faith in our team.

This should resolve the matchmaking concerns we've seen.
